subject: Beacon working group: status, day 20
body:
Team,

Status as of tonight.

QoE: databook expected tomorrow from Harrow & Finch. Management interviews set for day 26.
Legal: contracts summary due tomorrow. Purchase agreement first turn is waiting on the banker's draft.
HR: census in hand. Comp and benefits review blocked until the seller sends plan documents.
IT: systems inventory in progress. Cyber assessment site visit to schedule.
Financing: two term sheets in. Lender sessions with the CFO next week.

Open with the seller: add-back support, monthly working capital, litigation list. All three past due.

Owen
